notes.title: Terranova Featured in Famitsu, Denfamico Gamer and Indie Tsushin
notes.notes:
[h2]Holy cow, we're on Famitsu Japan![/h2]

October was a big month for us. Back in September we announced that [url=https://ko-fi.com/post/%E3%83%86%E3%83%A9%E3%83%8E%E3%82%A6%E3%82%A1%E3%81%AE%E3%83%86%E3%83%A2%E7%89%88%E3%82%92%E8%B2%A9%E5%A3%B2%E4%B8%AD-Terranovas-demo-is-now-available-T6T0PGVR3]Terranova's demo version had been translated into Japanese by Kimitaka Ogawa.[/url] Ogawa-san worked on Coffee Talk and A Space for the Unbound. In the few days after our release, we were featured in [url=https://news.denfaminicogamer.jp/news/231018y]Denfamico Gamer[/url], and shortly after, we were on the front page of [url=https://www.famitsu.com/news/202310/18321023.html]Famitsu Japan[/url].

We are so thankful to Ogawa-san, to the folks at Indie Tsushin, and to our loyal fans who flooded our Japanese itch.io page with support. <3 Never did we think Terranova would garner this much attention. We're humbled and grateful.

[h2]Indie Tsushin talks with us about our "dark history"[/h2]

CJ here. One of the things I've been enjoying in recent coverage of Terranova is the acknowledgement of both the player, and our, collective "dark history" (黒歴史) as cringey teens on the internet. mabbees and I did our first interview as a studio for the October issue of Indie Tsushin.

For anyone who roleplayed on BBS, AIM, Livejournal, Skype, Discord...I see you. It's a fun interview, I think you'd like it.

[url=https://indietsushin.net/posts/2023-10-25-Interview-with-Studio-Terranova][b]See the full interview on Indie Tsushin here.[/b][/url]

[url=https://nicegeargames.itch.io/indie-tsushin-2023-october][b]Indie Tsushin promotes indie games from Japan. You should check them out.
Help us translate Terranova[/b][/url]

We're going to translate Terranova in five parts. [url=https://illuminesce.itch.io/terranovajp]Part One has been translated and is up on itch.io.[/url]  All sales of the game from here on out are going into funding Part Two. In Terranova game time, that's January~April 2004. As for other languages like Russian and Brazilian Portuguese, well...we're currently looking for a publisher to see if we can localize Terranova to other languages.

At time of writing, we are already at 14% of our goal. Please help us translate the next part by donating and spreading the word. Your support means the world to us. 

[url=https://ko-fi.com/studioterranova][b]Donate to us on our Ko-Fi[/b][/url]

Your friendly neighborhood devs,
CJ & mabbees

notes.title: Terranova: One Year Anniversary Edition
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41628600/90e5566e0b6c879399f76393b5e4b983b8bd14a7.png[/img]

Can you believe it's already been a year?

In celebration for Terranova's one-year anniversary, we've made some major game updates that we hope you'll enjoy. Buckle in, it's going to be a long one.

[h2]Silver Mode UI and Wallpaper Customization[/h2]

First up, are a couple new settings.

You can now pick your desktop wallpaper from any of the wallpapers you’ve unlocked in the story so far. You can also set your UI to silver mode — you know, so your friends will know what a 1337 h4x0r you are.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41628600/b5f9c881b4b7bb1c787d6635dd4ca84c816fda61.png[/img]

[h2]New Wallpapers and In-Game Achievements[/h2]

There are  three endings in the game: bad, neutral, and perfect. One theme we noticed was that players were getting the neutral ending and wondering  if there was "more" to the game. 

There is! With this update, you’ll unlock a new achievement and a new wallpaper with each ending you clear. There are also achievements for story branches you may have missed, and of course, for solitaire bragging rights.

[h3]Bugs Still in Steam Achievements[/h3]
Steam Achievements currently do not link to the in-game achievements. We discovered this and mentioned it in this very post, but [i]Steam seems to have eaten it.[/i] Anyway. We apologize for the inconvenience to Steam users; we are working on it and will post an update later this month (July) as we diagnose and fix the issue. The achievements are in Steam, but the code-to-Steam link is not working.

Thank you for your patience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41628600/a0a29bced4b3a89f6f716cd96568a88ddc06af75.png[/img]

[h2]Updates to Cherry's Blog[/h2]

Cherry draws. [i]A lot.[/i] We thought it would be fun to add in more illustrations from Cherry into her blog—especially around her and Tourmaline.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41628600/0dc64b63c7874f81b1cd164afae0df00ac6382b6.png[/img]

[h2]Updates to Sendaria's Blog and Chats[/h2]

It has come to my attention through feedback from players that Sendaria's route, in particular in reference to her eating disorder—were not handled well. Tourmaline's character is meant to be somewhat insensitive and unaware—but parts of the game crossed the line. I am sorry to players, especially those struggling with a very real disorder, who saw this exchange as reflective of being dismissive of their own struggles.

I've rewritten parts of Sendaria's story to give a window into her life in Japan and family life. I've also rewritten some of the exchanges between her and Tourmaline towards the end of the game. Overall, I've been happy to spend more time in Sendaria's world and show the player a bit more of her fears and uncertainties.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41628600/b5f9c881b4b7bb1c787d6635dd4ca84c816fda61.png[/img]

[h2]And one last thank you to our players...[/h2]

We wanted to thank the players who have written us on Discord, itch, and Steam with kind words of support and feedback. In this past year, we have felt the pressure to get our game out to more people, to be *more big* and *more polished* just like bigger studios. One learning we've had is that we can't do that. Not only from a resource perspective, but commoditization of our game makes us faceless. We don't want that.

From a marketing perspective, we really appreciate retweets, shares and offers to appear in bundles. It helps us spread the word!

From a personal perspective, when we read comments or hear about word of mouth referrals, ("I shared this with my friends/my sister/my partner!") that really motivates us and gets us excited to work on more games.

Thank you always for your kind words and support.

Your friendly neighborhood devs,

CJ & mabbees

notes.title: Patch notes Terranova v1.2.0
notes.notes:
Hello fans and new players!

We’re Mabbees and CJ, the two devs behind Terranova. We are pleased to announce our first bugfix patch; we've been testing hard to make sure we got all of the issues folks had been contacting us about.

This patch fixes:
- issues with chats being locked, preventing progress in the game
- an issue where the game sometimes locks when loading a save
- the game going BSOD (Blue Screen of Death) when certain options were chosen
- drag and drop issues with Solitaire
- typos

Thank you to everyone who contacted us to let us know about the bugs. A very special thank you to players who fought through the bugs and still gave us so much love despite the issues.

We hope it's all smooth sailing from here, but if you do still run into bugs while playing, we'd like to know about them. We have a discussion open for bug reporting here: https://steamcommunity.com/app/1728700/discussions/0/5788831477021810552/

Your friendly neighborhood devs,
CJ and Mabbees

notes.title: Known Issues and How to Fix Them
notes.notes:
Hello y'all! 
Thank you to everyone who has been patient as we've gone through launch. We appreciate folks who reached out and provided us with reports.

There is an issue where Terranova locks the game that has been causing players frustration, which we'd like to show you how to fix.

[h2]Cannot Proceed Past April 2004[/h2]
In April 2004, there is the possibility for the player to get locked out of their chat with EphemeralSmile666, and become unable to proceed.

You can avoid this by following these steps:

- EphemeralSmile666 will start a conversation with you with the chat "Hey T, you're online!"
- [b]Do not respond to the chat. Wait until EphemeralSmile666 finishes typing completely[/b].
- EphemeralSmile666 will send you another chat: "I wanted to tell you this in person, but I didn't get the chance yet..."
- Continue playing as normal :)

If you are locked out, please reload your game from an autosave. [b]DO NOT OVERWRITE YOUR PREVIOUS SAVE IF YOU ARE LOCKED.[/b] Save in a separate file instead.

You can access the autosave from the Start Menu. Go to Save or Save and Quit. You will see this screen:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/XbZwMxs.png[/img]

[h2]Chats/Posting is Locked[/h2]
Sometimes on other months, posting in blogs and chats are locked and the player cannot end the month. In this case as well, please reload your game from an autosave. [b]DO NOT OVERWRITE YOUR PREVIOUS SAVE IF YOU ARE LOCKED.[/b] Save in a separate file instead.

[h3]I tried reloading the autosave multiple times. It's not working![/h3]
Most of the time reloading the autosave works to fix these issues, but if it is not working for you, please report this in [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1728700/discussions/0/5788831477021810552/]our bug report thread[/url] or [url=https://discord.gg/NUg8ny8Qv2]contact us on Terranova Discord[/url] through the #game-feedback channel. [i]Please note our server is 18+ only.[/i]

[b]Thank you all for playing the game and helping us make it better. We're doing everything we can to make sure everyone's game plays smoothly. A hotfix patch is currently in development![/b]

Thank you!
CJ & Matt

notes.title: Full Game Released!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!
Allow us to introduce ourselves. We’re Studio Terranova, i.e. CJ and Mabbees, the devs behind Terranova. We normally use Discord and itch.io to communicate with folks, but seeing as we have fans on Steam too, starting today we’ll be posting regular updates on this community. Hello! ːsteamhappyː

[h1]Full Game Has Been Released![/h1]
For those of you who played our free demo, thank you. We’re pleased to announce that the full game has been released on Steam for Windows and Mac!

[h2]The full game features...[/h2]
[list]
[*] A full ten hours of story, complete with romance, drama and plot twists galore
[*] Three unique endings that are based on your choices within the game
[*] Shiny new IM to chat your friends and away messages that change based on story
[*] Fully-functional Solitaire to play while you're chatting your friends
[*] Awesome new credits song by [url=https://gloomyjune.bandcamp.com/]Gloomy June[/url] and [url=https://theyaxes.bandcamp.com/]The Y Axes[/url]
[/list]

If you haven’t already…
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1728700/Terranova/]Check it out here.[/url]

[h1]We love reviews <3[/h1]
For those of you who have bought the game and loved it, if we can make a small request… every indie game’s first ten reviews are the most important. We would love it if you gave us a review and let us know what you thought of our game.

[h2]Want to keep in touch? [/h2]
We have a [url=https://discord.gg/NUg8ny8Qv2]Discord[/url] where you can chat us, get help with the game, and hang out with other nostalgia fans (and fellow role players). We’re starting a roleplay campaign within the Discord server soon… 

Thank you again for your continued support, and we’re looking forward to chatting more!

- CJ & Mabbees
